limitations: Metadata audit is not independent printed-grid or ground-accuracy verification.
Cartographic sheet dates are month-precision, not a date of survey for each object.
Margins outside official core contain legend and other non-geographic material.

printed_grid_checks.method: Manually identified visible 100m dotted printed-grid crossings; independently read source pixel locations, dark projection centroids within manually identified 9px strips. No fitted correction applied.
printed_grid_checks.interpretation: Scan/world-file agreement with printed cartographic grid only, not ground-control accuracy or survey accuracy.
